messages.subject: Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed() :
parts:
Hi,

I am working with a spatio-temporal model with SPDE approach, after create the mesh, have this error when i use the inla funtion.

Can someone suggest me ideas, please?

Joseph 

formula <- (logPM25 ~ + ALTITUD + WV + TEMPERATURA + HUMEDAD.RELATIVA + PRESION + RADIACION.SOLAR +
              f(field, model = spde, group = time,
                control.group = list(model="ar1")))

result <- inla(formula, data= D2015, family = "gaussian", verbose=TRUE)
